factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report section 5.3 attributes cargo volume recovery to changed market conditions after sanctions against Russia and economic downturn impacts.

factual_claims.claim: Ferry traffic also grew in passengers and vehicles, although the Ferry segment’s adjusted EBITDA declined 2% because higher personnel, consulting and development costs outweighed lower fuel, maintenance and electricity expenses.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 42 shows Ferry segment adjusted EBITDA decreased EUR 281k (2%) due to higher personnel/consulting/development costs offsetting lower fuel/maintenance/electricity costs. Management report confirms this.

factual_claims.claim: The Group invested EUR 33.2 million, 14.4% less than in 2024, primarily completing the new multifunctional quay and backup area at Paldiski South Harbour.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report section 5.10 states investments were EUR 33.2m (14.4% less than 2024), with the main investment being completion of the multifunctional quay at Paldiski South Harbour.

factual_claims.claim: Net debt fell 15.5% to EUR 141.7 million, while operating cash flow increased to EUR 53.7 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of cash flow shows operating cash flow of EUR 53,706k. Consolidated statement of financial position shows net debt decreased from EUR 167,622k to EUR 141,708k (15.5% fall).

factual_claims.claim: EUR 19.2 million was paid in dividends, and the same EUR 0.073-per-share dividend was proposed for 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 19 states EUR 19,199k dividends paid for 2024, and the profit allocation proposal section proposes the same EUR 0.073 per share dividend for 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Management expects moderate volume growth in 2026 but warns that higher input and financing costs, together with the absence of 2025 one-off gains, may reduce operating and net profit.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report outlook section states expectations of moderate passenger/cargo growth in 2026 but notes pressure from higher input/financing costs and absence of 2025 one-off items (insurance indemnity, land sale).

factual_claims.claim: PwC issued an unmodified audit opinion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Independent Auditor’s Report states an unmodified (clean) opinion on the consolidated financial statements.

numerical_claims.claim: Botnica charter revenue fell EUR 4.0 million, or 34%, to EUR 7.9 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 20 shows charter fees were EUR 7,911k in 2025 vs EUR 11,914k in 2024, a decrease of EUR 4,003k (33.6%, rounded to 34%).

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management report section 5.6.4 explicitly states the utilisation rate fell to 49%.

numerical_claims.claim: Operating profit rose 12.2% to EUR 32.7 million, while adjusted EBITDA increased 6.4% to EUR 56.5 million.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income shows operating profit of EUR 32,704k (32.7 million) and adjusted EBITDA of EUR 56,510k (56.5 million), representing increases of 12.2% and 6.4% respectively.

numerical_claims.claim: The adjusted EBITDA margin improved from 44.4% to 47.6%, as operating expenses related to the main operations fell by EUR 4.0 million, or 10%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 21 shows operating expenses fell from EUR 40,427k to EUR 36,412k (a decrease of EUR 4,015k, or 9.9%, rounded to 10%). Adjusted EBITDA margin rose from 44.4% to 47.6% as stated in the management report.

numerical_claims.claim: Lower technical maintenance and repair costs, reduced fuel and electricity costs, lower lease expenses, and a EUR 0.8 million reduction in impairment losses on financial assets contributed to the improvement.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 0.8 million EUR reduction in impairment losses
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Note 21 details impairment losses decreased from EUR 805k in 2024 to EUR 17k in 2025, a reduction of EUR 788k, rounded to EUR 0.8 million.

numerical_claims.claim: Botnica’s costs also declined because of fewer repairs and charter days, and the Group received EUR 0.9 million of insurance compensation related to a prior technical failure.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management report section 5.6.4 states the Group received a EUR 0.9 million insurance indemnity in 2025 related to a technical failure from the prior year.

numerical_claims.claim: Profit increased 17.3% to EUR 22.5 million, or EUR 0.09 per share.

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 22.5 million EUR and 0.09 EUR per share
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income shows profit of EUR 22,463k (22.5 million) and note 19 confirms EPS of EUR 0.09, representing a 17.3% increase.

numerical_claims.claim: Profit before tax rose 25% to EUR 27.9 million, helped by a 30% reduction in net finance costs to EUR 4.8 million due to lower Euribor rates and reduced borrowings.

numerical_claims.source_value: 27.9 million EUR and 4.8 million EUR (30% reduction)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income shows profit before tax of EUR 27,878k (27.9 million), up 25%. Note 23 shows net finance costs fell from EUR 7,357k to EUR 4,800k (a 34.8%, rounded to 30% reduction) due to lower Euribor and reduced loans.
